invariants.note: TWO THINGS MOVED THAT ARE WORTH READING BEFORE THE COUNTS. First: R6 raised residual doubt from 8 open defeaters to 11 while closing six incidents, and every one of the three new open doubts was ALREADY TRUE and unstated. DEF-ELIM-1PA-IMPL-FIDELITY was hiding inside a bare `elimination_refs` entry; DEF-FILTER-SUBSUMPTION was hiding inside an `is_ok` that cited deductive equivalence for a step that is not deductive; DEF-SHARED-CAUSE-DECLARED is the price of a new universal. Typing a mechanism does not create doubt, it relocates it from prose into the count. Second: the elimination of DEF-1PA-REDUCTION-MISMATCH now depends on a question no round has ruled. Under the ELIMINATIVE reading an open doubt lowers confidence and does not refute an inference, so the elimination stands; under the STRICT reading — Dung with no preference ordering, what an off-the-shelf solver does — the open doubt about the eliminator defeats it and the original doubt reverts. §9 computes both, they disagree on 7 records, and ASR-COMPILE-AF now has a witness set instead of a worry.
